question: For calendar Q2 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026), what was net revenue at Visa and at Mastercard, and by how much did Visa's exceed Mastercard's? Use each company's own reported quarter that corresponds to those dates and answer in USD millions.
grading: List of three: Visa net revenue USD 11,633M (fiscal Q3 2026), Mastercard net revenue USD 9,277M (Q2 2026), each ±0.5%; difference (Visa minus Mastercard) USD 2,356M ±1% (Visa about 25% larger). Optional: YoY growth Visa 14.4% vs Mastercard 14.1% (±0.3pp). Both quarters end 2026-06-30. Fail if Visa's March quarter or any non-matching Mastercard quarter is used.
answer: Visa's fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net revenue was USD 11,633 million, up from USD 10,172 million a year earlier (+14.4%). Mastercard's Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net revenue was USD 9,277 million, up from USD 8,133 million (+14.1%). Visa's net revenue exceeded Mastercard's by USD 2,356 million (about 25% higher). [T20-E1, T20-E2, T20-E3]

output.answer:
Both companies' quarters ended June 30, 2026 align exactly with calendar Q2 2026.

## Calendar Q2 2026 (April 1 – June 30, 2026) Net Revenue

| Company | Reported quarter | Net revenue |
|---|---|---|
| **Visa** | Fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) | **$11,633 million** (~$11.6B, +14% YoY) |
| **Mastercard** | Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) | **$9,277 million** (~$9.3B, +14% YoY) |

**Difference: Visa's net revenue exceeded Mastercard's by $2,356 million** (~$2.36 billion).

### Notes on the comparison
- **Visa** reports on a fiscal year ending September 30, so the April–June 2026 period is its fiscal third quarter (reported July 28, 2026). Exact figure: $11,633 million GAAP net revenue.
- **Mastercard** reports on a calendar year, so April–June 2026 is simply its Q2 2026 (reported July 30, 2026). Exact figure: $9,277 million net revenue (up 14% reported, 12% currency-neutral).
- Both figures are GAAP net revenue as reported by each company.

### Sources
- Visa Q3 FY2026 earnings release / 10-Q: [SEC filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403161/000140316126000103/q32026earningsrelease.htm) and [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403161/000140316126000104/v-20260630.htm)
- Mastercard Q2 2026 earnings (8-K): [SEC filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1141391/000114139126000081/ma-20260730.htm); figure corroborated by [TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:d4b484d6e9e9b:0-mastercard-reports-q2-2026-revenue-9-3b-net-income-4-4b-adjusted-eps-5-04) and [Tickeron](https://tickeron.com/blogs/mastercard-ma-delivers-strong-q2-2026-earnings-with-revenue-and-eps-beats-15173)

One caveat: figures are drawn from SEC filings as reported in search results; for the most precise cents-level values you'd want to open the earnings release financial tables directly.
